222-527-3899-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5946-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4871-5220-5946-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2469-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2741-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2741-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1017-1494-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3644-5147-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

997-2082-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
997-2082-3490-7426.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1322-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1558-3129-3147-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3129-3147-3875-4231.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-413-1322-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5220-6351-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-6351-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

856-5686-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1734-4605-5231-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-4605-5231-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

628-5231-7198.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

586-3375-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

560-1308-2457-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

224-1772-5233-6763.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-3967-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-3967-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

575-1477-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1477-5971.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it.
When Extruder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Extruder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Extruder enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Extruder face-up.
Resolve the Extruder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

862-2034-2232-5778.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Crimson Kobolds token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Crimson Kobolds, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5256-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Astrid, causing target player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

3827-5606-5607.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in your graveyard.
Klauth has power 5 or greater, or you control another creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Klauth, or any other creature you may need to attack with.
3827-5606-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and any other creature, if needed, as an attacker.
Klauth triggers, adding at least {4}{R/W}{R/W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Kirri triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding a land card, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

654-1227-3476-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
654-1227-3476-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Phantatog ability from step 2, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1909-4474-4875-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
"Elf" chosen with Conspiracy.
1909-4474-4875-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {G}.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Emmara.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1240-1355-3953-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Instill Energy attached to Sanctum Weaver.
You have not used Instill Energy's ability this turn.
1240-1355-3953-4618.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing Instill Energy.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Instill Energy from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability, regenerating it.
Cast Instill Energy from exile by paying {G}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-678-951.description:
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shivan Devastator from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3767-3784-4486.notablePrerequisites: Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3784-4486.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {3}, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 3/3 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Vhal by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

43-2751-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have a spell available to cast.
43-2751-5116.description:
Cast the spell, triggering Paradox Engine.
Tap Gilded Lotus for {3}.
Pay {2} and tap Strionic Resonator to copy the Paradox Engine trigger.
Resolve the copied Paradox Engine trigger.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite mana and nonland permanent untaps.

539-1247-3102.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-3102.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
